comment: The frequency input jack is named "Clock" by the maker (quadlfo.cpp:72) while the panel prints FREQ. It is read as a clock, not as a CV: the rate comes from the time between rises, clamped to 0.1 to 100Hz, and each rise resets output A's phase (quadlfo.cpp:186). The chaos at the top of the SHAPE travel is a Brownian random walk stepped once per cycle (quadlfo.cpp:86), which is separate from the Lorenz attractor the STABIL knob drives.
